passage: Scientists have found that octopuses can recognize individual ______ in one study, an octopus repeatedly squirted water at one particular researcher who had poked it, while ignoring others.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: A comma alone creates a comma splice, no punctuation creates a run-on, and “, and in,” adds an incorrect comma after “in.”
key: Two complete sentences need a period, semicolon or comma plus a conjunction.
